name: session-telemetry
description: Collects telemetry about each Claude Code session (hook runs, session events and skill use) from this plugin's hooks and from any plugin's hook-telemetry producers, for later analysis.

skill_usage_audit_enabled.title: Skill-usage-audit hook
skill_usage_audit_enabled.description: Emits telemetry on skill usage, on by default. Shared by both skill-usage audit hooks (the Skill-tool and slash-command expansion paths), and also gates the shared skill-usage.jsonl store.

skill_usage_scope.title: Skill-usage log scope
skill_usage_scope.description: Where the skill-usage store lives. repo (default) keeps it in the project tree, out of git status via a machine-local .git/info/exclude entry; user puts the skill_usage_dir subpath under $HOME as one cross-repo store; data-dir uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/skill-usage/<repo-slug>.

skill_usage_dir.title: Skill-usage log directory
skill_usage_dir.description: Relative directory where the skill-usage-audit hooks write skill-usage.jsonl, under the skill_usage_scope root (repo: the project root; user: $HOME). Leave unset to use .claude/observability. The data-dir scope ignores it. Absolute, drive, UNC, traversal, and escaping-symlink paths are invalid.

skill_usage_git_exclude.title: Git exclude for the repo-scope store
skill_usage_git_exclude.description: Adds the repo-scope store's directory to .git/info/exclude when it sits inside a git work tree, so git status stays clean. On by default; machine-local, and never touches .gitignore or tracked files. Set false if your team deliberately commits the telemetry.

skill_usage_max_bytes.title: Skill-usage file size cap (bytes)
skill_usage_max_bytes.description: Size at which a skill-usage producer rotates skill-usage.jsonl to skill-usage.jsonl.1, replacing any older .1, so the pair stays near twice this value. Default 10485760.

api_error_audit_enabled.title: API-error-audit hook
api_error_audit_enabled.description: Emits turn-failure telemetry on API errors. On by default.

config_change_audit_enabled.title: Config-change-audit hook
config_change_audit_enabled.description: Emits telemetry on config-source mutations. On by default.

instructions_loaded_audit_enabled.title: Instructions-loaded-audit hook
instructions_loaded_audit_enabled.description: Emits telemetry on rule and instruction file loads. On by default.

instructions_loaded_audit_log_session_st.title: Session-start instruction-load logging
instructions_loaded_audit_log_session_st.description: Makes the instructions-loaded-audit hook log session_start instruction loads. Off by default, because those loads are deterministic and high-volume.

permission_denied_audit_enabled.title: Permission-denied-audit hook
permission_denied_audit_enabled.description: Emits telemetry on permission denials. On by default.

pre_compact_audit_enabled.title: Pre-compact-audit hook
pre_compact_audit_enabled.description: Emits telemetry on context-compaction events. On by default.

tool_failure_audit_enabled.title: Tool-failure-audit hook
tool_failure_audit_enabled.description: Emits telemetry on Write, Edit, and Bash tool failures. On by default.

session_event_log_enabled.title: Session-event-log hook
session_event_log_enabled.description: Appends a JSON line to <session_event_log_dir>/sessions/<session_id>.jsonl per observable event in an enabled category. Runs in the hooks module, so it needs mods on. Off (the default), no event starts a process; on, each logged event starts one. It also gates SessionEnd retention.

session_event_log_dir.title: Hook log root directory
session_event_log_dir.description: Project-relative directory holding the per-session hook event log (sessions/) and the telemetry sink's hook-events.jsonl. Default .observability/claude. Absolute, drive, UNC, traversal and escaping paths are invalid, and the project root itself is refused.

session_event_log_categories.title: Session-event-log categories
session_event_log_categories.description: Comma-separated event categories to record (session, prompt, tool, permission, agent, task, turn, config, worktree, compaction, model, mcp, display, other). Empty, the default, records every observable category. An unlisted category starts no process; SessionEnd retention runs regardless.

session_event_log_content.title: Session-event-log content fields
session_event_log_content.description: Also records each event's top-level content strings (prompt, last_assistant_message, message, task text, error and the like) in the session event log; content the 64 KB read cap cuts is marked truncated. Off by default; has no effect while session_event_log_enabled is off.

session_log_keep_sessions.title: Session files to keep
session_log_keep_sessions.description: At SessionEnd, keeps the newest N session files regardless of age; default 30. A file is kept when it is among the newest N OR younger than session_log_keep_days.

session_log_keep_days.title: Session file retention (days)
session_log_keep_days.description: At SessionEnd, keeps every session file younger than N days regardless of count; default 14. A file is kept when it is younger than N days OR among the newest session_log_keep_sessions.

session_log_pre_prune_command.title: Pre-prune command
session_log_pre_prune_command.description: Command run detached at SessionEnd with one argument: a directory holding the session files about to be pruned, deleted on the next retention run after 24 hours. Leave unset to delete directly. Runs through bash -c, so only your own user settings can supply it.

hook_events_max_bytes.title: Hook events file size cap (bytes)
hook_events_max_bytes.description: Size at which the telemetry sink rotates the shared hook-events.jsonl to hook-events.jsonl.1, replacing any older .1, so the pair stays near twice this value. Default 10485760. Applies whether or not the per-session event log is on.

stdin_read_timeout.title: Hook stdin read timeout (seconds)
stdin_read_timeout.description: Idle bound on reading the hook payload from stdin: how long the pipe may go silent before the hook gives up and fails open. Default 2.
